description: Complete reference for Frontline's four built-in CRM objects: People, Companies, Deals, and Tickets. Covers their pre-defined fields (including read-only and programmatic ones), built-in relations, background automations (auto-creation, enrichment, RAG sync), profile/summary UI behavior, and deduplication rules. Read this before adding fields or creating records on these objects — many behaviors run automatically and must not be duplicated manually.
